In this notebook, I will make plots for Supplemental Figure 6

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpmisc)

thisseed <- 231103

colFGID <- "#1E88E5"
coliCD <- "#55D276"
colcCD <- "#FFC107"
colUC <- "#D81B60"
diagSubColVec <- c("FGID"=colFGID, "iCD" = coliCD, "cCD"=colcCD, "UC"=colUC)

colCelltypes <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 7, "Set1")[c(1:5,7)]
names(colCelltypes) <- c("ColEpi", "Stroma", "Myeloid", "Plasma", "BCell", "TNKILC")

source("../functions/ComparisonPlottingFxns.R")
```

```{r}
seuobj <- readRDS("data/objects/annotated/predictCOL__CB_allcells_annotated_251017_v4.rds")
seuobj
```

# Gene Expression

```{r, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=28}
PlotBoxplotsFeatures(seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% droplevels, 
                     seurat = "seuobj", 
                     sample.col = "cellstate",
                     features = "STAT1",
                     exportSampleDF = T) %>% 
ggplot(aes(x = meanVal, y = reorder(cellstate, meanVal))) + 
  geom_col(aes(
    color = celltype,
    fill = ifelse(cellstate %in% c("TFPI2Hi Fibro.", "Inflm. Mac", "Th1", "Treg", "XCL+ NK"), 
                  "darkred", "gray70")),
    lwd = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = percent(percentVal, 0.1)), size = 5.5, fontface="bold", nudge_x=0.155, hjust = 0.5, color="black") +
  # geom_text(aes(label = cellstate_count,fontface="bold")) + 
  scale_y_discrete() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "identity", breaks = pretty_breaks(5), expand=expand_scale(add=c(0,0.155))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("gray70" = "gray70", "darkred" = "darkred")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colCelltypes) +
  # scale_fill_gradient(low = "gray80", high = "lightpink") +
  # scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Mean Log-Normalized STAT1 Expression"
  ) +
  theme(
    # panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size=16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size=16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size=14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = unit(c(0.25,0,0.25, 0.25), "cm")
  ) +
  labs(y = NULL, fill = NULL, color = NULL) + 
  guides(fill = "none", color = guide_legend(nrow = 1))
```

```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=7}
PlotBoxplotsFeatures(seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% droplevels, 
                     seurat = "seuobj", 
                     sample.col = "cellsubtype",
                     features = setdiff(sort(unique(c(
                       rownames(seuobj)[grepl("IFNA", rownames(seuobj))],
                       rownames(seuobj)[grepl("IFNB", rownames(seuobj))],
                       rownames(seuobj)[grepl("IFNL", rownames(seuobj))],
                       rownames(seuobj)[grepl("IFNG", rownames(seuobj))]
                     ))),"IFNG-AS1"),
                     exportSampleDF = T)  %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = cellsubtype, y = featureVar, fill = meanVal)) +
  geom_tile(color = "gray50", lwd = 0.5) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) + 
  labs(fill = "Mean Log-Norm. Exp.") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", angle = 45, hjust=1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", vjust=0.85),
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.margin = unit(c(0.25,0.25,0.25,0.25), "cm")
    ) + 
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 30))
```

# Regressions


```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=14}
SenderReceiver(
  seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(timepoint == "T0"),
  senderCol = "cellsubtype",
  senderVal = c("Thelper", "NK", "CTL", "InvariantT"),
  features.sender = c("IFNG"),
  senderProp = FALSE,
  xLab = "STAT1 Expresion",
  receiverCol = "cellstate",
  receiverVal = c("TFPI2Hi Fibro.", "Inflm. Mac", "Th1", "Treg", "XCL+ NK"),
  features.receiver = c("STAT1"),
  receiverProp = FALSE,
  yLab = "IFNG Expression",
  minSenderFreq = 10,
  minReceiverFreq = 10,
  facetType = "grid",
  facet_scales = "free_x",
  r2level = 0.999, 
  ncols = 10,
  swap_facets = T,
  doTests = F,
  exportSampleDF = T
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = receiverExp, y = senderExp)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, aes(fill = diagSub), size = 4) +
  stat_poly_line(method = "lm") +
  stat_poly_eq(method = "lm", use_label(c("R2","P")), size=6) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(3)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(3)) +
  facet_grid(senderName~receiverName, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    y = "IFNG Expression",
    x = "STAT1 Expression",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.25, "cm")
  )
```
